text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over 24 hours, but the broader market is holding relatively steady with altcoins mixed—suggesting consolidation rather than panic. The Fear & Greed index sits at 65 (Greed) and has climbed 19 points in a week, indicating growing confidence despite the minor pullback. Bitcoin's dominance near 59% paired with $82B in daily volume reflects solid participation across the market, pointing to a cautious optimism where investors are neither fleeing nor aggressively accumulating.
